title: 📺 A Patent from "Google": An AI TV Channel.. and You Are Its Star!
body: 📺 A Patent from "Google": An AI TV Channel.. and You Are Its Star!

"Google" registered a patent for what it calls "My Channel": a TV channel running around the clock, generating its programs with AI specifically for you, and making you the star of everything you watch in it.

The idea works by having the system read your demographic data, viewing history, and favorite genres, then ordering a video-generation model to create a personalized video in which the user plays the hero, following the style of what they watch most and their favorite genre, with a new story every time.

The patent imagines examples such as a crime adventure and comedy, a romantic comedy, a science-fiction adventure, or an action thriller, starring a viewer named "John", and it even suggests that if someone watched highlights of a particular cricket player, they might be offered a video cheering that player from the stands or interacting with him.

The channel is also linked to an ad server that inserts personalized ads inside the generated content itself, a new sign that the endgame of AI video is endless content personalized for each person individually.

But the patent remains just a registered idea: companies register many patents that never become products, and it was preceded by a patent from "Microsoft" describing a system that changes spoken words and lip movement in live video.
Simply put: a TV that does not show what it shows to everyone.. but makes you a film in which you are the star, with ads made for you too.. so would you watch a channel no one else watches?
Do you want an AI-generated TV channel where you are the star of all its programs?
